root_cause.text: The `atmel_sha204a_remove` function had an early return when the device was considered busy (`tfm_count > 0`), preventing proper cleanup (unregistration of hwrng, flushing of the I2C workqueue, removal of sysfs entries, and freeing of `->hwrng.priv`), which could lead to a use-after-free if a queued work or a concurrent `->read()` callback accessed freed memory, and also caused a memory leak.
